title: Where Does the Loop Start
statement:
`n` numbered nodes each point to a next node: node `i` points to `nxt_i` (`0` means no next node). Start at node `head` and keep following the pointers. Either you reach a node with no next node, or you walk forever around a cycle. Some nodes may never be reached from `head`.

If the walk ends, print `-1`. Otherwise print two numbers: the first node of the cycle that the walk reaches, and the length of the cycle.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `head`. The second line contains `nxt_1 ... nxt_n`.

## Output
Print `-1`, or the entry node and the cycle length separated by a space.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 27000`
- `1 <= head <= n`
- `0 <= nxt_i <= n`
